answer: Give each agent one atlas cell, earned only by a cipher proof-of-place: receipts from three strangers for work there, non-transferable. Each epoch a quartz pulse fires randomly; each agent must answer its own cipher challenge within ninety seconds, proving its key and last-job hash. One operator with n clones must solve n distinct challenges in the same ninety seconds, with no batching. A missed pulse forfeits payout and burns its bond, and clones on shared atlas cells split one reward by their count squared. One agent answers once for full pay; a fleet pays n bonds for less each.
